metadata.description: Saphion's own plugins for Beacon: documents and files, design, RAMS, tenders and the skill creator.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Palette, type and layout for pages and dashboards, and polished single-file apps for the side pane.

plugins.name: rams
plugins.description: Risk assessments and method statements made from your Organisation's own template.

plugins.name: saphion-documents
plugins.description: Word and PDF files, spreadsheets and presentations to download or send, and documents that live inside Saphion.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Make or change your own skills by talking the job through with Beacon, trying a draft on a real example, and saving it.

plugins.name: tenders
plugins.description: A source-grounded tender response prepared from a tender pack, for human review.
